title: Break and Continue
description: Learn how to control loops dynamically using the emergency eject button (break) and the skip button (continue)!

content.value: Sometimes, you want to stop a loop early or skip a specific turn. Python gives us two magic spells to do this: `break` and `continue`.
The `break` spell immediately ends the loop, even if the loop condition is still True! It is like pulling the emergency eject handle on a ride.
The `continue` spell doesn't stop the loop. It just skips the rest of the current turn and jumps straight to the next spin!

practice.question: Modify the code to print numbers from 1 to 5, but skip the number 3 using the continue keyword.

quiz.question: Which keyword immediately exits the entire loop?
quiz.explain: `break` jumps straight out of the loop and stops it completely. `continue` only skips one turn, and `pass` does nothing.

quiz.question: What does 'continue' do inside a loop?
options: Skips the rest of the current turn and starts the next one.
quiz.explain: `continue` skips whatever is left in the current turn and jumps back to the top to start the next one.
